scope: Diagnostic collection/analysis resource use, not adaptive inference latency
envelope_scope: All wall time from first collection attempt start to last completion; includes restarts, provenance waits and head fitting, hence conservatively bounds collection and its bookkeeping overhead.
peak_memory_scope: OS high-water mark sampled during live HMDB adapter; includes provenance/collection/head. Not an isolated CPU-analysis peak.
disk_scope: New study results and ignored feature-cache directories, excluding existing datasets/environments and Git/source-code overhead; measured before commit.
